findings.title: Dynamic file read lacks the repo's established nolint:gosec pattern
findings.detail: checkRange's os.ReadFile(resolved) reads a path built from the agent's citation string (external input), validated only by runtime logic (EvalSymlinks/Rel checks), yet the comment argues 'gosec's G304 does not fire here' and omits a //nolint directive — diverging from the two other patterns this codebase uses for exactly this situation: archive.go:386 (`//nolint:gosec // G304: p is produced by WalkDir...`) and cmd_review.go:228 (`//nolint:gosec // G703: dest is inside the run's bundle dir...`). The one precedent for omitting the directive, internal/doctor/review_record.go:49-50, is a materially different case — its path component comes from a closed two-value enum (spec|plan), not from agent-supplied JSON as here. The task brief itself explicitly asked for `//nolint:gosec // G304: the path is constrained to the resolved repository root above`, which this diff does not add. If gosec still flags this (its G304 rule generally does not trace runtime validation logic back to safety), the wave's own lint/verify step fails.

findings.title: Newline-flattening fix applied to PriorFindingLines but not to its twin CandidateLines
findings.detail: This diff adds `lineSafe` to collapse newlines in PriorFindingLines' free-text `f.Detail` before rendering one-finding-per-line (brief.go:244), with a doc comment explaining that an unflattened multi-line Detail would 'arrive as several [findings]' to the reviewing agent. CandidateLines (brief.go:202-208), a few lines above in the same file, renders VerifyCandidate.Detail — the same kind of free-form, agent-authored prose (from lens-review findings, wired through cmd_next.go:884) — in the exact same one-per-line format, with the exact same unflattened `c.Detail`. The identical hazard this diff explicitly fixes in one place is left live in the structurally identical sibling function it did not touch.
